stem: What is the best summary of the section titled “Texas’s Special Salamander”?

options.label: A
options.text: Aquifers keep water deep underground. The Austin Blind Salamander swims in an aquifer.

options.label: B
options.text: The Austin Blind Salamander only lives in the Edwards Aquifer in Texas. It has special features that help it live there.

options.label: C
options.text: The Austin Blind Salamander has red gills. It is a small creature that can be different colors.

options.label: D
options.text: There is an important aquifer beneath the spring in Barton Springs, Texas. Different types of salamanders live there.
